title: Underwater Oceanic Sunbeams
subtitle: Snell's Law Refraction, Surface Caustics & Marine Cathedral Light
description: Underwater light simulation illustrating sunlight penetrating deep oceanic waters. Computes Snell's law refraction through dynamic surface waves, creating volumetric cathedral light shafts, surface caustics, and illuminated schooling fish silhouettes.
mathNotation: n_1 \sin \theta_1 = n_2 \sin \theta_2, \quad I(z) = I_0 e^{-c z}, \quad \mathcal{C}(x, y, t) = \left| \det \left( \mathbf{J}_{\text{refract}}(x, y, t) \right) \right|^{-1}
formulaCompact: n_air sin(θ_i) = n_water sin(θ_t),  I(d) = I_0 exp(-αd) · wave_caustics(x, t)
